tip_title: Thanksgiving Is Days Away. Here's the One Thing Most Hosts Never Think to Check.
topic: Home Insurance - Holiday Hosting Liability and Premises Coverage
blurb:
💡 **Insurance Tip: Thanksgiving Is Days Away. Here's the One Thing Most Hosts Never Think to Check.**

When you've got family and friends in the house for the holidays, your personal liability coverage is quietly doing a job most people don't think about until something goes wrong. If a guest slips on a wet floor, trips on the front steps, or gets hurt in some other way on your property, your homeowners policy's liability coverage is what responds first. The question worth asking before Thursday is whether the limit on your policy still makes sense for the household you have today, not the one you had when you first bought coverage. A lot of people set that number once and never look at it again.

Not sure what your liability limit is or whether it's still the right number? Your Peachy agent can pull it up and walk you through it in a few minutes.

📖 [Learn more from the Insurance Information Institute](https://www.iii.org/article/insuring-your-home-based-business)
summary: Covers personal liability coverage on homeowners policies framed around Thanksgiving holiday hosting, specifically the risk of guest injuries on the property and whether the existing liability limit is still adequate for today's household.
scoring_notes: Thanksgiving is literally days away from November 20 — peak hosting relevance. Prior liability tips (Aug 24, Sep 7, Sep 11) covered the default $100k limit number, the three liability tiers, and the scenario-level claims walkthrough. This tip takes a fresh angle: the holiday-hosting prompt to check whether the number is still right for the current household, not a first-time education moment. High homeownership rates in both audiences (78%+) means virtually the whole readership is a potential host. Actionable this week.
